title: Prosciutto and Menemen Turkish-Style Breakfast
description: A twist on the traditional Turkish menemen, adding crispy prosciutto and a smoky twist with jagged spices.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together eggs, menemen spice mix, smoked paprika, and salt.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add prosciutto and cook until crispy.
Pour egg mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until eggs are cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast Turkish bread and cut into quarters.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with garlic.
Serve eggs with crispy prosciutto, garlic, and toasted bread on the side.
Garnish with jagged spice to taste.
